description: The 2027 Brough Superior AMB 002 Roadster combines design, innovation, craftsmanship, and exclusivity, aimed at discerning road riders and collectors. Production is limited to 300 units, featuring a CNC Titanium frame and a powerful 1,083cc V-twin engine.
The 2026 BMW X5 introduces a new design language along with a variety of engine options, including hybrid and hydrogen variants, ensuring performance and efficiency.
The 2026 BMW iX5 became the first all-electric X5, combining the fifth-generation SAV's Neue Klasse-inspired design with long range, rapid charging, and dual-motor all-wheel drive.
BMW unveiled the 2026 i3 as the brand's first compact executive sedan designed from the start as a fully electric model that combines 3 Series driving dynamics with advanced EV technologies.

The 2026 BMW 7 Series refreshed its design with updated drivetrain options, including mild-hybrid and plug-in hybrid engines, as well as a fully electric variant. It combines luxury with advanced technology, particularly in its interior features.

The 2026 BMW i7 is the electric version of the refreshed 7 Series, featuring technological advancements and improved battery range, offering a luxurious interior and high-performance driving dynamics.

Lexus introduced the 2027 TZ model as its first three-row battery-electric SUV, which also played as a new luxury alternative to the TX range. Built on the TNGA platform, it offers a spacious cabin with sustainable materials and advanced technology features.
The 2026 Audi Q4 e-tron improved Audi's electric entry point with sharper styling, a more advanced cabin, greater efficiency, bidirectional charging, and stronger everyday usability.
The 2026 Dacia Spring is a reinvented small electric vehicle featuring fresh styling and a spacious cabin, designed primarily for urban use with a range of 250 km (155 miles).

In 2026, Volvo refreshed its entire 40 range, and among them, the EC40 received a significant update that improved its styling and technology. This compact electric crossover coupe combines an elevated stance with a sleek design and advanced safety features.

Ferrari created the 2026 CZ26 as a one-off for an American customer, wrapping the SF90 Stradale's plug-in hybrid powertrain and chassis in completely redesigned bodywork with a retro-futuristic appearance.
The 2026 Mercedes-Benz VLE is a new generation of luxury vans that blend limousine-level comfort with van practicality, offering long electric range and advanced onboard technologies.
In 2026, Volvo updated its EX40 model, enhancing its electric crossover's styling and technology, while maintaining a focus on spaciousness and driver comfort.

In 2026, Volvo refreshed its entire 40 range, and among them, the XC40 received a significant update that sharpened the compact crossover's styling and improved its cabin and technology. The updated variant came with substantial styling improvements and better safety and driver-assistance technology.
The 2026 Renault Niagara is a midsize pickup designed for both personal and commercial use, offering a rugged appearance and a range of modern features.

With the 2026 Ferrari Amalfi Spider, the Italian car manufacturer expanded its grand touring sports car range, blending high-performance engineering, everyday usability, and the pleasure of driving under a clear sky.
The 2027 Range Rover Electric combines the fifth generation's familiar design and off-road abilities with a fully electric drivetrain, maintaining Land Rover's luxury standards.

The 2027 Honda NT1100 Electronic Suspension is a touring motorcycle featuring advanced rider aids and a powerful engine. It offers a blend of comfort and high-performance capabilities for enthusiasts.

The 2027 KTM 690 Rally is a dual-sport motorcycle designed for adventure seekers, featuring an extended range and rally-inspired performance. Built on the proven KTM 690 Enduro R platform, it excels in challenging terrains.

The 2025 Brough Superior RMB01 is a luxury motorcycle resulting from a partnership with Richard Mille, featuring high-end craftsmanship, technological innovation, and a limited production run of 150 units.

The 2020 Brough Superior AMB 001 is a track-only motorcycle featuring a high-performance 997cc V-twin engine producing 180 hp. Limited to just 100 units, it combines Aston Martin design with Brough Superior engineering.

The Brough Superior AMB 001 Pro is a product of a collaboration between Aston Martin and Brough Superior, featuring a powerful 997cc turbocharged V-twin engine that produces 225 hp. Limited to 88 hand-built units, this motorcycle is inspired by Aston Martin's Valkyrie AMR Pro hypercar.

description: The 2026 Denza Bao 5 is a medium-sized SUV that offers a combination of luxurious interiors and a potent plug-in hybrid drivetrain, designed for both on-road comfort and off-road capability.

The 2026 Denza Z Coupe is a high-performance supercar featuring a tri-motor all-electric drivetrain with a total power output of 1604 hp. It boasts advanced aerodynamics and cutting-edge technology to enhance driving dynamics.
Created as the brand's flagship SUV, the 2027 Genesis GV90 combined a powerful electric drivetrain with three-row seating, advanced technologies, and limo-like comfort.
